text: On-site security can help construction teams manage access and site activity when crews are away. Property Security Services, Inc provides trained, uniformed security personnel and can discuss a site-specific service scope. Requested coverage hours, duties, and pricing are confirmed directly with the company.
Construction sites may contain equipment and materials that require attention outside regular work activity. Security personnel can be assigned to duties discussed with the construction supervisor.
We offer the following services to construction sites

items: Access control for site personnel, visitors, vendors, and equipment
Patrol the construction site at agreed intervals
Observe and report unusual activity and site conditions
Maintain visitor and vendor logs as requested
Prepare daily activity reports
Follow site instructions provided by the construction supervisor

text: Property Security Services, Inc provides our clients the most excellent security service so they can focus time and energy on their business. Our primary goal is to ensure that your establishment is safeguarded.

items: The security guard will arrive at your facility prior to closing.
If a vehicle is required, the security guards vehicle will have a strobe light on the roof. In addition, a plaque will be displayed on both sides of the vehicle marked security.
The security specialist will roam (via vehicle or foot patrol) the area, where the trailers and equipment are parked looking for any suspicious activities.

The specialist will roam the area in random intervals at a minimum of two to three times an hour. If in fact there is any devious commotion, the guard will call 911 immediately, followed by your designee and then to his immediate supervisor.

The security guard will keep a log on times he roamed the facility in addition to any relevant information. Any employee who enters the facility on off peak hours will be logged in and out. The employee will need to have their employee badge with them and provide a reason for entering the facility. If the employee does not have his/her id badge, they will not be allowed to enter the facility without permission from your designee.
Ensure good communications with the construction supervisor and confirm communications frequently.
Ensure all paperwork is neat and orderly.
Meet with the construction supervisor daily to discuss any security issues.
Perform access control into the construction site.
Maintain a visitor log, vendor log and any other logs required by the construction supervisor.
Any other security responsibilities required by the construction supervisor.

text: Our management will review and revise existing post orders, subject to your review, or create post orders where there are none, and review them with you to ensure that they accurately reflect your instructions. Daily activity reports will be maintained at your site and will be distributed accordingly per your instructions. Incident reports will be filled out and distributed in a manner and procedure you designate. We will use forms developed at your facility or provide them where there are none. All personnel will use their best efforts to observe and report any physical facility problems they observe such as damages, breakage, plumbing problems, and other reportable occurrences immediately in a manner or procedure that you designate.

Property Security Services, Inc proposes to provide a Uniformed Private Unarmed Security Officer during the hours required. Security officer will be responsible for monitoring the jobsite, patrolling, maintain necessary paper work, signing after-hour workers out of the property and roving within the facility periodically.

Property Security Services, Inc offers on-site trailer packages with an officer who can patrol the grounds when employees leave for the day. Officers can observe and report site activity and document it in daily reports. A customized security package and any trailer or equipment requirements are discussed with the client and confirmed as part of the service proposal.

A trailer-based post may provide an on-site base for officer activity and reporting, depending on the selected service package. Staffing, equipment, and reporting responsibilities are confirmed with the client before an assignment.

items: Each security officer is provided with a telephone or radio and shall make random foot or car patrols around the job site.
Lighting to cover the security trailers at the job site.
Sufficient warning signs to be posted around the perimeter fence of the job site.
